title: High Risk Third Countries list updated after FATF plenary
summary: HM Treasury has updated its advisory notice on High Risk Third Countries under the Money Laundering Regulations. The update reflects changes to the FATF lists agreed at its October 2026 plenary.
what_changes: The advisory notice sets out which countries are High Risk Third Countries, as defined in the Money Laundering Regulations.
High Risk Third Countries are the countries listed by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF).
The 11 November 2026 update reflects changes to the FATF lists made at its October 2026 plenary.
who_it_applies_to: Firms doing work in scope of the Money Laundering Regulations.

history.event: Advisory notice updated to reflect FATF list changes from the October 2026 plenary.
